title: the MM2 letter D part 2 - the deva turn
audit_label: R800 MM2 letter D part 2 audit
audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTER D PART 2 - the deva turn of the Monster Manual II arc (the user Go call on the landed letter D part 1). The pin-time walk from the print finds THREE entries on pp. 42-44: the astral deva, the monadic deva and the movanic deva. THREE defs ride the R791 data_files extension in the MM1 registry schema - no form splits in the deva family. THE GRID: the 3-row DevaStats stat grid (every armor class, hit-dice, hit, xp, lair, move and magic-resistance cell of the three stat blocks). THE SETTLED READS: the monadic ARMOR: -4 capture line is the armor class line; the monadic and movanic LEVEL prints IX (the capture 1X is the OCR misread); the astral LEVEL prints the roman X; the movanic size keeps the print 6 1/2 inches form. NO GAP FLIPS (the Letter D box flips only when all the D parts land - the R791 no-flip precedent). NO XP-AUDIT PATCH (mm2_print rides the allowed-source list since R797). The live def walk (the one file-patch site block, no census marker) cross-checks all 3 defs against the DevaStats grid and the registry census floor 563 -> 566.

banner.title: THE MM2 LETTER D PART 2 - the deva turn (the DEVA family at the foot of p. 42 with the astral, monadic and movanic deva stat blocks on p. 43), promoted to the live registry
banner.provenance: Round four of the MM2 arc, the second PART-LETTER walk (the user Go call on the landed letter D part 1: the letter D continues with the deva family pp. 42-44; the DEVIL section and the rest of D await the user call). The capture is the Curtiss PDF upload cross-checked against an independent transcription; the contested cells settled: the monadic deva ARMOR: -4 capture line is the ARMOR CLASS line (the transcription prints the class word); the monadic and movanic LEVEL prints IX (the capture 1X is the same OCR misread class as the atomie II); the movanic size keeps the print 6 1/2 inches form; the movanic prose runs onto p. 44 where the DEVIL section opens mid-page. The pin-time walk finds three deva entries; three .lua defs ride the R791 data_files extension, registry 563 -> 566. The stat blocks pin in the 3-row DevaStats grid (the armor class, hit dice, hit, xp, lair, move and magic-resistance cells); the deva-common doctrine (the material-body rule, the spell-like list with its per-day maximums, the attack-form immunities with the monadic fire exception) pins as round-level doctrine. NO GAP FLIPS: the Letter D box flips only when all the D parts land (the R791 no-flip precedent). NO XP-AUDIT PATCH: mm2_print already rides the allowed-source list (the R797 patch). The live def walk (the one file-patch site block, no census marker) cross-checks all 3 defs against the DevaStats grid and the registry census 563 -> 566 as a floor.

-- (spec tools/spec_r800.json); DO NOT hand-edit; the pin headers

  text = "Astral devas are principally employed in the Astral Plane or on any of the outer Lower Planes. Alone or in groups, they move about in service to their sovereigns. They are very quick, whether afoot or using their mighty pinions in flight. An astral deva normally carries a huge, macelike weapon which it can wield nimbly. This weapon is of +3 value when employed by an astral deva. Any creature struck twice in the same melee round and suffering damage in excess of 20 hit points must save vs. spell or be knocked senseless for 14 rounds. The weapon also acts as a mace of disruption (q.v.) with chances to hit as if wielded by a 9th-level cleric. An astral deva can use the spell-like powers given above, at will, 1 per round, to the applicable maximums. Light shed by an astral deva can have a 4-40 foot radius, as desired. The protection from evil is a sphere with a 10-foot radius of normal (+2) power. An astral deva can also dispel illusion, dispel invisibility of any sort, polymorph self, or remove curse, all also 1 per round. Once per day an astral deva can create a blade barrier which will last for up to 7 turns. Astral devas can never be surprised. It requires a +1 or better magic weapon to harm them. Total vacuum does no harm to astral devas. They are immune to life level loss, whether from undead or magic. Their souls cannot be trapped or imprisoned. They are immune to death spells. Their charisma effect is 20. Astral devas are tall, slender, and graceful. They have golden skin and hair, amber eyes, and large white wings tinted with gold. They otherwise resemble humans.",
}
